Beach assets — integration record / 2026-10-07

Source: 3DAssets.dev, Beach Surf and Paddle Kit
Pack: https://3dassets.dev/packs/beach-surf-and-paddle-kit
License stated by publisher: CC0 1.0 Universal
License reference: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Public downloads. No signup, Google login, purchase, or account creation was used.

Imported 9 assets:
Beach umbrella, beach ball, volleyball, beach chair, beach mat,
sandcastle, beach fence, driftwood, surfboard.
The volleyball model is imported for optional reuse. The playable map uses the beach-ball model.

Used original geometry and palette materials. Converted GLB node transforms and
handedness to flattened mesh JSON, then imported as Unity mesh/prefab/material.
No downloaded scripts, native libraries, packages, or installers were executed.
Planks, mirror frame, gates, shelters, signs and gameplay scripts are project-authored.

Publisher discloses AI-assisted asset geometry generation (Claude Opus 5.5).
The imported models contain geometry/materials; physics, lighting and gameplay
integration in this project are implemented separately.

Raw GLBs and download hashes:
에셋/Beach_Surf_and_Paddle_Kit_3DAssets/download-records.json
Unity copy:
Assets/ThirdParty/3DAssetsBeach/download-records.json
Assets/ThirdParty/3DAssetsBeach/LICENSE.txt

Earlier gallery/library assets retain their existing source and license records.
CC0 for this beach pack does not change the licenses of those other assets.


Entrance refresh — 2026-11-01

Added three geometry-only assets from the same public CC0 pack:
Surf Hire Hut (hirehut), Stocked Surfboard Rack (boardrack), Cooler Box (cooler).
These fixed environment objects decorate the rental and picnic clusters outside
the central entrance-to-receiver walking corridor and the castle sightline.
Detailed source URLs, original-byte SHA256, bounds and triangle counts are in
Assets/ThirdParty/3DAssetsBeach/refresh-download-records.json.
The previous nine model JSON files and their meta GUIDs were preserved.
New raw GLBs, the official manifest snapshot and source download hashes are in
the workspace .tmp/beach-refresh-assets directory.
Only the previously local geometry-conversion function was reused; no downloaded
scripts, packages, native libraries or installers were executed.
Materials keep the kit palette; collision, lighting and gameplay are authored locally.
